pattern: a local usage hub needs its key added without exposing it
experience: An agent could verify a local proxy's individual accounts but could not add its usage source without editing live server files or asking the user to use the settings screen.
prompt: Add my CLIProxyAPI usage hub to this T3 server. It listens at http://127.0.0.1:8317 and its management key is in the existing owner-only file /home/user/.local/share/proxy/management-key. Do not print the key.
notes: The source and key path are fictional. Main does not expose the usage source add tool.

pattern: ask for the management key privately and pass its reference
experience: A usage hub needs a user-provided management key without placing its value in chat or tool inputs.
prompt: Add my local CLIProxyAPI hub at http://127.0.0.1:8317 to T3 Usage. I can provide its management key privately.
notes: No real key or account is used.
